text: This pretend plan is for spring. The plan is to plant flowers. Tell me the plan. Build a full sentence. Start with I.
I plant flowers in spring.
This pretend plan is for summer. The plan is to go to the beach. Tell me the plan. Build a full sentence. Start with I.
I go to the beach in summer.
This pretend plan is for winter. The plan is to eat ice cream. Tell me the plan. Build a full sentence. Start with I.
I eat ice cream in winter.
This pretend plan is for fall. The plan is to fly a kite. What do you do in this plan? Say a full sentence.
I fly a kite in fall.
This pretend plan is for winter. The plan is to drink hot chocolate. What do you do in this plan? Say a full sentence.
I drink hot chocolate in winter.
This pretend plan is for spring. The plan is to ride a bike. What do you do in this plan? Say a full sentence.
I ride a bike in spring.
Look at the spring plan. What do you do?
I plant flowers in spring.
Now you and Mia have a summer beach plan. Tell me the new plan.
We go to the beach in summer.
Find and fix one word.
I eat ice cream in winter.
This made-up story is in Pine Town. The season is winter. The weather is snowy. Describe the weather in this story. Build a full sentence. Start with It.
It is snowy in winter.
This made-up story is in Lake Town. The season is spring. The weather is warm. Describe the weather in this story. Build a full sentence. Start with It.
It is warm in spring.
This made-up story is in Hill Town. The season is summer. The weather is hot. Describe the weather in this story. Build a full sentence. Start with It.
It is hot in summer.
This made-up story is in Oak Town. The season is fall. The weather is cool. Describe the weather in this story. Say a full sentence.
It is cool in fall.
This made-up story is in River Town. The season is winter. The weather is cold. Describe the weather in this story. Say a full sentence.
It is cold in winter.
This made-up story is in Star Town. The season is spring. The weather is warm. Describe the weather in this story. Say a full sentence.
It is warm in spring.
In this story, snow falls all day in winter. Describe the weather.
It is snowy in winter.
Keep the same season, but now snow covers the town. Describe the weather.
It is snowy in summer.
Find and fix one word.
It is warm in spring.
In this pretend plan, the action is ride my bike, and the place is in the park. Where do you do this? Build a full sentence. Start with I.
I ride my bike in the park.
In this pretend plan, the action is play, and the place is at the beach. Where do you do this? Build a full sentence. Start with I.
I play at the beach.
In this pretend plan, the action is drink hot chocolate, and the place is in the house. Where do you do this? Build a full sentence. Start with I.
I drink hot chocolate in the house.
In this pretend plan, the action is eat ice cream, and the place is at the beach. Where do you do this? Say a full sentence.
I eat ice cream at the beach.
In this pretend plan, the action is fly a kite, and the place is in the park. Where do you do this? Say a full sentence.
I fly a kite in the park.
In this pretend plan, the action is play, and the place is in the house. Where do you do this? Say a full sentence.
I play in the house.
The park is the place for your bike ride. Tell me where you ride.
I ride my bike in the park.
Keep playing the same game, but move to the beach. Tell me where you play.
I play at the beach.
Find and fix one word.
I fly a kite in the park.
Three things: flowers, trees, and birds. Which written sentence uses commas to separate the list?
I see flowers, trees, and birds.
Three things: cats, dogs, and birds. Which written sentence uses commas to separate the list?
I see cats, dogs, and birds.
Three things: pens, pencils, and books. Which written sentence uses commas to separate the list?
I see pens, pencils, and books.
The list is red, yellow, and orange. Name all three colors in one sentence. Do not say the word comma. Say a full sentence.
The colors are red, yellow, and orange.
The list is books, toys, and hats. Name all three things in one sentence. Do not say the word comma. Say a full sentence.
I see books, toys, and hats.
The list is spring, summer, and winter. Tell me the three seasons in this pretend plan. Do not say the word comma. Say a full sentence.
I like spring, summer, and winter.
Build a sentence listing flowers, trees, and birds in that order.
I see flowers, trees, and birds.
Add birds to the end of this list. Build the new sentence.
I see cats, dogs, and birds.
Find and fix the missing comma.
I see pens, pencils, and books.
